question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's firm grip on the Chinese Communist Party, Central Military Commission, and state institutions underpins trader consensus that he will remain in power through the end of 2026. Ongoing anti-corruption purges targeting senior military and political figures have further neutralized potential rivals, while recent gatherings such as the Beidaihe retreat signal continued emphasis on loyalty and party discipline ahead of the 2027 National Congress. No verified health incidents or public challenges to his leadership have emerged in the past year, and analyses consistently point to expectations of a fourth term rather than early exit. Realistic shifts could still arise from an abrupt medical event, major foreign policy setback, or elite realignment, though these remain low-probability within the narrow timeframe.

question: Will Gavin Newsom win the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination?

eventMetadata.context_description: The closely matched top contenders in this 2028 Democratic presidential nomination market reflect a fragmented field two years out, with traders pricing in uncertainty over post-2024 party direction, candidate electability across swing states, and the impact of the DNC's proposed early primary calendar in South Carolina, Nevada, New Hampshire, and other states.
